content.text: Pakistan's thriving creative economy faces a harsh reality: without access to Stripe or PayPal, digital creators are forced to choose between limited payment options and compromised security. The stakes are high: delayed payouts, high fees, and even outright payment failures can derail a creator's entire business. But what if there was a way to break free from this cycle of dependence and take control of your own commerce infrastructure? With NOWPayments and COREMERCH, the answer lies in building a sovereign digital store that runs on your terms, not someone else's. In this guide, we'll show you how to set up a NOWPayments digital store from scratch, giving you the freedom to sell your digital products with confidence and consistency.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The problem with platforms like Stripe or PayPal is that they hold your commerce infrastructure hostage. When their systems fail or their terms change, your business is the first to suffer. With NOWPayments and COREMERCH, you own the infrastructure from day one. Our stacks are built on open-source tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase, giving you the flexibility to customize and scale your store as needed. And with NOWPayments' 0.5% fee structure and 300+ cryptocurrency support, you can say goodbye to high fees and hello to a more secure and reliable payment experience. By building a sovereign digital store, you're not just creating a business – you're creating a sustainable future for your creative endeavors.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can set up your NOWPayments digital store, you'll need a few essential tools and a solid understanding of the infrastructure. First, you'll need to choose a stack from COREMERCH's lineup, including the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack. Next, you'll need to set up a domain and hosting for your store, which can be done with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Finally, you'll need to configure your payment and delivery pipeline using NOWPayments and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. With these pieces in place, you'll be ready to deploy your store and start processing transactions like a pro.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With your stack and hosting in place, it's time to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. Using NOWPayments, you'll need to configure your payment methods, including cryptocurrencies and fiat currencies. Next, you'll need to integrate your delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, which will handle file delivery for your digital products. Be sure to test your pipeline thoroughly to ensure that everything is working as expected. With a solid payment and delivery pipeline in place, you'll be able to process transactions and deliver products to your customers with ease.

Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

The moment of truth has arrived: it's time to go live and process your first transaction. Once you're ready, you can launch your store and start processing transactions. Be sure to keep a close eye on your analytics and adjust your infrastructure as needed to optimize performance. With a little practice and patience, you'll be processing transactions like a pro and taking control of your commerce infrastructure like never before.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your business grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to keep up with demand. With NOWPayments and COREMERCH, scaling is a breeze. Simply upgrade your stack or add new services as needed, and you'll be able to handle increased traffic and transaction volumes with ease. Be sure to monitor your analytics and adjust your infrastructure accordingly to ensure that you're always running at peak performance. With a scalable infrastructure in place, you'll be able to grow your business with confidence and take on new opportunities with ease.
